q: Which chemicals made in Cilegon fall under EU CBAM?
title: Cilegon chemicals under CBAM
short: Only a few. Hydrogen (2804 10 00), ammonia (2814), nitric acid (2808) and nitrogen fertilisers (3102 and 3105) are CBAM goods. Polymers, methanol, chlor-alkali products and other petrochemicals are not in Annex I, so exporting them to the EU needs no CBAM figure today.
audience: Chemical and petrochemical producers in the Cilegon industrial estates of Banten, Indonesia, exporting to the EU

ul: 3102 and 3105: nitrogenous and mixed fertilisers, with indirect emissions included.
Chapter 39 plastics in primary forms, such as polyethylene and PVC.

p: EU buyers of uncovered chemicals may still want a product carbon footprint for their own Scope 3 reporting. Keep fuel, steam and electricity records by plant so one can be built.

senseible: Senseible reads the energy invoices behind the making stage into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, and keeps material invoices on the Scope 3 trail. Material factors come from your supplier or a named database and are labelled with their source, so the product figure can be traced line by line.
